source.title: Continuous Variation of Cauchy Data Spaces. Task - Results - Open Problems

accepted.question_text: Let M be a smooth compact Riemannian manifold with boundary Σ, let E and F be Hermitian vector bundles over M, and let A: C^∞(M,E) → C^∞(M,F) be an arbitrary first-order elliptic differential operator. How special are operators of Dirac type in comparison with such general first-order elliptic operators? More concretely, to what extent can the boundary-value and Cauchy-data-space properties known for Dirac-type operators also be obtained for arbitrary first-order elliptic operators, including a product-form reduction near the boundary, a canonical invertible double, well-behaved Poisson and Calderón projections, self-adjoint Fredholm extensions, and continuous variation of these structures under perturbation?
accepted.context_brief: Cauchy data spaces for first-order elliptic operators
